title: FAPS BENGALURU ANNOUNCES NEW AI & ROBOTICS LAB
subtitle: The Frank Anthony Public School continues its legacy of academic excellence with state-of-the-art STEM infrastructure for senior students.

articles.title: FAPS BENGALURU ANNOUNCES NEW AI & ROBOTICS LAB
articles.author: By Editorial Staff
articles.excerpt: The Frank Anthony Public School, Bengaluru, has inaugurated its state-of-the-art AI & Robotics Innovation Hub, equipping students with future-ready skills in coding, machine learning, and automation.
articles.content:
In an effort to keep pace with rapid technological advancements, The Frank Anthony Public School, Bengaluru, today inaugurated its brand-new Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Center. The ribbon-cutting ceremony was attended by distinguished alumni, faculty, and student leaders.

Speaking on the occasion, the Principal emphasized the importance of blending academic rigor with hands-on technological exposure. "Our motto, 'Courage is Destiny', inspires us to embrace future challenges with confidence and curiosity," he noted.

articles.excerpt: The campus resonated with pride and nostalgia as students paid tribute to founder Frank Anthony during the annual solemn assembly.
articles.content: Annual Founder's Day at FAPS Bengaluru was marked by patriotic music, speeches, and inter-house debates honoring the memory of Late Mr. Frank Anthony.
